title: Raku Firing Workshop
summary: Hands-on raku workshop where you glaze and fire your own bisque pieces. Bring up to four bisqued pieces and choose from Raku glazes; finished pieces are taken home the same day.
how_to_join: Explore dates via workshop page link
source_quote:
Raku Firing Workshop
Choose from a range of raku glazes to create effects from lustrous metallic to dramatic crackle.
evidence_sentence: The Alternative Firings workshop page describes a hands-on Raku Firing Workshop where participants glaze and fire bisque pieces using traditional methods.
evidence_quote: Experience the process of Raku in our hands-on workshop, where you glaze and fire your own bisque pieces using traditional methods.
